issues.on_page: Non-Revenue Receipts 289,062.48 = General Fund 39,062.48 + Depreciation Fund 250,000.00 ('5200 Allocation from General Fund', Sched C p18)
issues.issue: 250,000 is coded 5200 (the same object code as 'Transfer from Other Funds' on Sched A p15 and Sched F/G) and described as an allocation from the General Fund, so it is economically an interfund transfer. However the General Fund shows no matching transfer out (only 60,000 on p8/p31), and Exhibit II/III print it as a receipt ('Other' general receipts p4; Non-Revenue Receipts p5-6) inside the printed total 6,789,722.55. Keeping it as printed is defensible and the extractor flagged it with review; user should decide whether to treat it as a transfer.
